```{r}
#| label: Demographics

library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
data_ppt <- read.csv("../data/rawdata_participants.csv")

data_task <- read.csv("../data/rawdata_task.csv")

table(data_ppt$media_professional, useNA = "ifany")

# Create demographics comparison table
demo_table <- data_ppt %>%
  select(
    media_professional,
    Gender,
    Age,
    Education,
    Discipline,
    Student,
    Ethnicity,
    Country
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = media_professional,  # Group by TRUE vs FALSE
    missing = "no"            # Keep missing values as their own category
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%                  # Add statistical test for each variable
  modify_header(label ~ "Media Professional") %>%
  bold_labels()

demo_table

```

```{r}

library(psych)
library(dplyr)

# Make sure the variables are numeric
data_task <- data_task %>%
  mutate(
    enjoyable = as.numeric(Enjoyable),
    likeable = as.numeric(Likeable),
    pleasing = as.numeric(Pleasing)
  )

# Check internal consistency
alpha(data_task[, c("Enjoyable", "Likeable", "Pleasing")])

# Create the composite variable
data_task <- data_task %>%
  mutate(aesthetic = rowMeans(select(., Enjoyable, Likeable, Pleasing), na.rm = TRUE))


```

```{r}
library(psych)
library(dplyr)

# Make sure the variables are numeric
data_task <- data_task %>%
  mutate(
    expressive = as.numeric(Expressive),
    emotional = as.numeric(Emotional)
  )

# Check internal consistency
alpha(data_task[, c("Emotional", "Expressive")])

# Create the composite variable
data_task <- data_task %>%
  mutate(emotional_expressive = rowMeans(select(., Emotional, Expressive, Pleasing), na.rm = TRUE))

```
